description: Asks Piqline's guest agent a question, no account and no key. It answers only from what Piqline publishes openly: the weekly advertising 'temperature' of French niches (active advertisers, newcomers, leavers), the 'who said it first' timelines already published, the professions it has pages for, its technologies, and the public home page of a website you name. It never sees any workspace or private data and cannot start a collection. Answers cite their source page and date. Limited per day; when the door is closed it says so. For a watch of your own and the full tools, create a free account; the structured result gives the links (getStarted).

question.description: A question about Piqline's public data or about what Piqline can do.
